notes: Daydream Scope's longlive pipeline (LongLive 1.3B base generator + its LoRA) with VACE enabled, driven as Scope's Video input mode with 'Use Input Video' off (frontend default): 12 live source frames (3 latent frames) per call as latent initialisation (Scope video-mode defaults for longlive: noise_scale 0.7, noise controller, denoising steps [1000, 750]); the reference image as VACE R2V conditioning (context scale 1.0), sent once after each reference change (Scope app semantics, the same policy as scope_sdv2_vace). One reference slot: set/patch/remove/reset applied when the resulting state has exactly one slot, otherwise acked unsupported (2+ slots or an empty state). Reference prompt: 'Replace the <slot scope target> in the video with the one from the reference image, ...' (same template as JoyAI-Video-Edit). Output 832x480 (480x832 portrait, center crop) at 16 fps.
